baby_development: Baby gains weight, organs mature, and usually turns head-down for birth.
mother_symptoms: Shortness of breath, heartburn, swelling, Braxton Hicks contractions, trouble sleeping.
diet_advice: Small frequent meals, plenty of protein and iron, limit very salty or fried food. Stay hydrated. Continue prenatal vitamins.
warning_signs: Heavy bleeding, severe pain, water breaking, fewer baby movements, severe headache or vision changes.
